# DeepSeek-V4 tokenizer resources

The files `tokenizer.json`, `tokenizer_config.json`, and `encoding_dsv4.py` are
copied from the official `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731` model repository.
They are used only to render and count the prompt before an API request.

Source: https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731

The upstream MIT license is included in this directory.
